prompt.text:
Implement a complete TypeScript source file exporting `CredentialRecord`, `AuthenticatedProfile`, and `authenticateLocal`. A credential record has `userId`, `displayName`, `email`, `avatarKey`, and `password`. `authenticateLocal(records, email, password)` returns an `AuthenticatedProfile` without the password. Reject malformed stored records: all string fields must be nonempty after trimming and stored emails must contain exactly one `@` with nonempty text on both sides. Reject duplicate stored emails case-insensitively. Login email comparison is case-insensitive, but password comparison is exact. Blank login credentials, an unknown email, or a wrong password must throw `new Error('Authentication failed')`. An empty record list is valid but cannot authenticate. Do not mutate or expose any input object.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
